purpose: Catalog three newly verified Taiwan photobooks with format-specific physical and digital editions, separate covers, and only currently orderable retail offers.

works.title: 遠在謙邊：關於未知的我們 CP寫真書
works.composition: BL劇《關於未知的我們》遠在謙邊CP邱宇辰與黃宏軒的全新合拍寫真，描繪戲劇之外的未來甜蜜日常，收錄多樣造型與約150張新拍照片；紙本首刷附隨機復刻拍立得。

editions.label: 精裝大開本紙本寫真書
editions.metadataNote: 台灣角川產品頁確認紙本上市日2024-05-03、售價NT$600、內容含約150張全新合拍照片及首刷隨機復刻拍立得；目前顯示售完，未記錄為可購買商品。

editions.label: 固定版面 EPUB
editions.metadataNote: BOOK☆WALKER固定版面EPUB電子版；EISBN 9786264001465，與紙本 ISBN 9786264001472 分開辨識，電子封面亦與紙本不同。

activeOffers.evidence: BOOK☆WALKER Taiwan product page showed active digital checkout at NT$450, fixed-layout EPUB and EISBN 9786264001465. This is a current digital asking price, not a completed sale.

works.title: 謝佳見：臨界之地Land Boundary
works.composition: 謝佳見第二本個人寫真書，以14種造型拍攝其不同面貌，結合照片、日記式文字、自我反思及陳怡庭插畫。

editions.label: 平裝版
editions.metadataNote: 三民紙本頁確認平裝、144頁、ISBN 9786263160231、攝影謝宏奕；頁面目前無現貨，但可下單採購，預估4至10個工作天。

activeOffers.evidence: Sanmin Taiwan showed NT$612 and an enabled add-to-cart/order path, with procurement estimated at 4–10 business days despite out-of-stock status. This is an orderable backorder asking price, not an in-stock offer or completed sale.

editions.label: 固定版面 EPUB
editions.metadataNote: BOOK☆WALKER固定版面EPUB列145頁、EISBN 9786263161634；電子版獨立使用電子封面。內容概述與紙本相同，但紙本頁數不套用到電子版。

activeOffers.evidence: BOOK☆WALKER Taiwan showed active fixed-layout EPUB checkout at NT$408 and EISBN 9786263161634. This is a current digital asking price, not a completed sale.
Sanmin Bookroll Taiwan showed the EPUB product with active add-to-cart at NT$408 and EISBN 9786263161634. This is a current digital asking price, not a completed sale.

works.title: 陳彥名#Y1闖入
works.composition: 陳彥名的影像日記寫真，以咖啡廳打工時的觀察與咖啡筆記、籃球場上的熱血及居家生活呈現演戲之外細膩的一面。

editions.label: 台灣特刊紙本寫真書
editions.metadataNote: 博客來確認台灣出版、出版社質男幫、封面人物陳彥名、出版日期2018-07-12、條碼4718008486882；產品明確顯示已售完且不能購買，因此此紙本版僅保留出版紀錄，沒有建立有效價格或把條碼誤存為ISBN。

editions.label: 固定版面 EPUB

activeOffers.evidence: BOOK☆WALKER Taiwan showed the fixed-layout EPUB with active checkout at NT$399 and 110 pages. No ISBN/EISBN was exposed on the product page. This is a current digital asking price, not a completed sale.
